Peru administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 25   
- Admin 2: 196   
- Admin 3: 1873   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 14 July 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 24 July 2015: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 24 July 2015: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rolac).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
remaining_reasons: Actual 1,873 polygon geometries and named administrative purpose not yet inspected.
Source edit/creation 24 July 2015, humanitarian valid-from 14 July 2020, quality-review 30 October 2025 are different dates; none can be substituted for the represented geometry vintage.
Peru gbOpen ADM3 and gbAuthoritative ADM3 requests returned 404; this is a separate licensed gbHumanitarian source, not identical gbOpen evidence.
Require complete rural/urban territorial coverage, preserved identity migration and geometry/grid rebuild before import.
